title: pvComputeDerivatives
body:
## pvComputeDerivatives

Computes derivatives of point data at each cell's parametric centre and stores them as cell arrays: ScalarGradient (gradient of the selected point scalar) or Vorticity as the vector output, and VectorGradient (9-component tensor) or Strain as the tensor output. Input point and cell data pass through. Use it for cell-wise gradients of point fields on any mesh; use gradient or pvGradient for point-centred gradients and Q-criterion.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The selected arrays must be point data; cell-centred solver fields give no derivatives, so convert them with cellToPoint first.
- By ParaView default both a scalar gradient and a vector gradient are requested; set OutputVectorType or OutputTensorType to Nothing for what you do not need.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ComputeDerivatives`. Identity: `filters/CellDerivatives`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OutputTensorType` | This property controls how the filter works to generate tensor cell data. You can choose to compute the gradient of the input vectors, or compute the strain tensor of the vector gradient tensor. By default, the filter will take the gradient of the vector data to construct a tensor. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Nothing","Vector Gradient","Strain"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Nothing"` |
| `OutputVectorType` | This property controls how the filter works to generate vector cell data. You can choose to compute the gradient of the input scalars, or extract the vorticity of the computed vector gradient tensor. By default, the filter will take the gradient of the input scalar data. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Nothing","Scalar Gradient","Vorticity"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Nothing"` |
| `Scalars` | This property indicates the name of the scalar array to differentiate. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Vectors` | This property indicates the name of the vector array to differentiate. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
